verification_policy: Exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused source review for structured changes. One combined target build. Native inspection only for uncertain behavior; reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of Karn and Mercadian Masques definitions. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
review_notes: 54 alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared substitutions; 12 structured definitions receive focused source review and one combined target build.
Karn retains ordinary exile versus commander tracking, ordered first/second commander matches, hand-selection fallback, detach paths, planeswalker returns and cast-flag clearing.

Restart retains separate Aura/commander and hand/battlefield reverse scans, live current-turn snapshots, commander byte flags, two stack sweeps, companion/plane exclusions, player-indexed energy resets and draw callback restoration of both globals.

Remembered permanents preserve the pre-sentinel packed card-data load, owner correction, commander callback order, cursor advancement before fallback entry and after commander entry, and inclusive count_rfg cleanup. Native disassembly confirms the pre-sentinel load and inclusive cleanup.

Masques alternative costs keep cancellation, payment and target-selection differences: Crash selects after a fizzle, Thunderclap gates it, Rouse still delegates to generic_spell, and Tidal Bore checks fizzle before and after generic_spell before AI scoring.

Aura event gates, War Tax cleanup/resolution, Ceremonial Guard and Outrigger blocker triggers, Ghoul Feast checks and Jeweled Torque cast-trigger/life payment preserve original callback order and return behavior.
No historical replay, new tests, broad native semantic harness or reccmp refresh for this readability batch.
